bit string types.name: command
bit string types.description: specifies the purpose of the message: 1 request, 2 response.

bit string types.name: version
bit string types.description: ripng version number; this document describes version 1.

structure types.name: ripng message

fields.name: command
fields.description: specifies the purpose of this message.

fields.name: version
fields.description: version of ripng; version 1 is described in this document.

constraints: n <= floor((mtu - ipv6 header size - udp header length - 4) / 20)

parsing context.name: mtu
parsing context.description: maximum transmission unit of the medium, used to determine the maximum number of rtes.

parsing context.name: ipv6 header size
parsing context.description: size in octets of ipv6 header(s) preceding the ripng message.

parsing context.name: udp header length
parsing context.description: size in octets of the udp header.

parsing context.name: current next hop
parsing context.description: next hop address from the most recent next hop rte; applies to subsequent rtes until another next hop rte or end of message.

helper functions.name: calculate max rtes
helper functions.description: computes the maximum number of rtes: int((mtu - sizeof(ipv6 hdrs) - udp hdrlen - ripng hdrlen) / rte size).

helper functions.name: is next hop rte
helper functions.description: returns true if the metric field of an rte equals 0xff, identifying a next hop rte.

bit string types.name: ipv6 prefix
bit string types.description: ipv6 destination prefix, 16 octets in network byte order.

bit string types.name: route tag
bit string types.description: route tag attribute assigned to a route, preserved and readvertised.

bit string types.name: prefix length
bit string types.description: length in bits of the significant part of the prefix, 0 to 128 inclusive.

bit string types.name: metric
bit string types.description: route metric, 1 to 15 inclusive, or 16 for infinity (unreachable).

fields.name: ipv6 prefix
fields.description: the 128-bit ipv6 address prefix stored as 16 octets.

fields.name: route tag
fields.description: attribute assigned to a route, preserved and readvertised.

fields.name: prefix length
fields.description: number of significant bits in the prefix, starting from the left.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: current metric for the destination, or 16 for infinity.

packet.name: next hop route table entry format

bit string types.name: ipv6 next hop address
bit string types.description: ipv6 address of the immediate next hop; 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0 means the originator of the advertisement.

bit string types.name: must be zero 16
bit string types.description: must be zero on sending and ignored on reception.

bit string types.name: must be zero 8
bit string types.description: must be zero on sending and ignored on reception.

bit string types.name: next hop metric
bit string types.description: value 0xff identifies this rte as a next hop rte.

fields.name: ipv6 next hop address
fields.description: ipv6 address of the next hop; must be link-local, or zero to indicate the originator.
constraints: ipv6 next hop address is link-local or 0:0:0:0:0:0:0:0

fields.name: must be zero 1
fields.description: must be zero on sending and ignored on reception.

fields.name: must be zero 2
fields.description: must be zero on sending and ignored on reception.

fields.name: next hop metric
fields.description: fixed value 0xff identifying a next hop rte.
